fields.v:
Model Claude 3.5 Sonnet for both; agent/harness Not stated. Criterion: first-attempt compile + tests pass; violations; tokens. One run per feature, 15 features (Table I).
- Monolithic Context (baseline) + agent n.s. + Claude 3.5 Sonnet: 48,500 tokens/feature; first-attempt success 40%; 12 architectural violations (5 rewrites of core files)
- MicroSkill Architecture + agent n.s. + Claude 3.5 Sonnet: 3,200 tokens/feature (-93.4%); 86.6%; 0 violations; 7 new capsules
Verdicts: quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors (all configurations)
